svg.title: End-to-End Structured Game-State Transition Model
svg.desc: Panels (a) and (b) show the transition encoder and entity decoder. The blue cross-panel connection transfers source entity tokens H_s, deterministic plan P, and posterior sample z_q. The KL term shown in the encoder corresponds to the KL term in the decoder training objective. Panel (c) is an expanded view of Shared Feature Encoders in panel (a); the gray dashed leader indicates this detail relationship, not data flow. Every diagram, label, formula, token and connector remains editable SVG.
